tagline: The card. The number. The miss.
confidence_key: BET = fire a unit. LEAN = half unit or skip if tight. FADE = posted because every game needs a number; would not fire real money.

NFL: Split the side from the scorer. They are two tickets.
A run-identity favorite is a real number.
A home favorite of a touchdown or more is live to leak.
A travel-week or short-week favorite is live to fade.
A total under 45 is a dog-and-points number, not a quarterback stack.
CFB: Fire 6-to-14 point ranked sides in real Power or conference games. Do not lump them with paycheck numbers.
A late-lead dog in a 1-to-3 point ranked game still has a number.
A 28-plus vs FCS can cash and still is not a fire. Stamp stays FADE.
MLB: A plus-money dog still needs the starter to keep it close after three innings.
Confirm the lineup at first pitch. A bat that does not play is a void.
Split the bat from the chalk ML.

NFL: Yards are not touchdowns. Volume is not a captain and it is not an anytime.
A fat road dog is not a system. The offense has to move.
Do not copy one final onto the next slate.
Do not lay brand juice home or road.
Do not buy points against a featured home back.
Do not chain WR1 or TE TD onto a dog you already like.
CFB: A 50-point FCS win is not a fire the next week.
Do not lay 20-plus on the road after a one-score opener.
A 50-0 G5 tape is not a road license against a Power host.
A 28-point home favorite with starters out is a pass.
A rivalry dog keeps a ranked favorite inside a touchdown.
MLB: Do not lay home juice worse than -200.
Do not glue Friday's final onto Saturday's rematch.
A plus-money dog is one game, not a series.
